name: @pinyinduck/android
description: Gradle wrapper for the PinyinDuck Android input method
comment: This package is a Gradle project. Gradle is the build system; this file makes
`packages/android` a member of the npm workspace, so `npm install` at the repository
root does not try to treat it as an application, and gives it the `ci` script every
`npm run ci -w @pinyinduck/android` runs what CI runs: ktlint, the unit tests, and the
coverage report and gate. Everything else is a Gradle task:
./gradlew check                  # tests plus the coverage gate
